prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ORIGINAL production game background asset, very wide landscape composition about 2:1. An empty ordinary small American wooded-town residential street, viewed straight across from a ground-floor house window at human eye height. Across the street two aging modest timber houses, sloping shingled roofs, small dark windows and porches, utility poles and telephone wires, uneven trees behind. Empty road in lower quarter, short neglected garden edges. No people, no monsters, no vehicles, no text, no UI, no foreground window frame or curtains. Strong atmospheric hand-painted illustration: simplified slightly crooked silhouettes, uneven brush-painted color shapes, restrained scratchy contour edges, flat blocked shadow masses, intentionally imperfect domestic architecture, visibly illustrated surfaces. NOT a photograph, NOT photoreal, NOT a pristine 3D render, NOT pixel art, no PS1 effects. Muted dirty cream plaster, dull olive wood, deep cool teal-green shadows, overcast pale grey-green sky. Readable hazy daylight, subdued psychological horror unease without extreme darkness or overt supernatural imagery. Gentle green ambient light with a few dirty yellow reflected highlights. Keep house silhouettes and trees detailed enough to read through a narrow window opening; no center focal object. Image is a game environment background that will be visible behind real 3D window frames and a 3D fence, so don't paint a surrounding interior. No recognizable scenes or assets from existing games.
